frozenBefore: any decoder was scored against the rehearsal-heavy model
gateSetPolicy: The eligibility gates are reused UNCHANGED for the third consecutive study. Pilot v2 failed on fragmentation and regions-per-minute; a decoder study that moved those bounds would be answering its own question.

baseModel.note: Weights are NOT retrained or modified. This study varies only the decoder applied to a fixed set of network outputs.

strategy.description: Score the frozen rehearsal-heavy checkpoint under alternative decoders, applying the unchanged pilot gate set. One forward pass per item serves every candidate, so the decoder axis is isolated exactly.
rationale: Measured in pilot v2: rehearsal-heavy passed every ACCURACY gate on both domains - GuitarSet root +6.04/+3.19 pp, GuitarSet detailed +11.59/+8.19 pp, full-mix detailed +12.17 pp - and failed only fragmentation (+0.0568/+0.0209 against 0.015) and regions per minute (+2.92/+1.46 against 0.75). Every gate it failed is a segmentation gate.

Measured in segmental-v3: segmental decoders cut fragmentation 0.672 -> 0.649 and regions/minute 22.2 -> 20.8 on the full-v2 model without costing accuracy. That study rejected them because they missed frozen bounds NARROWLY on a model whose accuracy was not gate-clearing; the decoders have never been applied to a model in this family that already clears the accuracy gates.

Measured across temporal-v2, segmental-v3 and boundary-v3: boundary-head interventions move fragmentation by about +/-0.014 while decoder changes move it by an order of magnitude more. Decoding is the lever with the demonstrated effect size.
A decoder study needs no training, so the full candidate set costs one forward pass over each item plus negligible decode time.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Pilot v2 already showed that objective-side interventions on this family move the chord posterior more than the segmentation behaviour, and retraining would confound the decoder question with a weights question.
Tuning switch/duration/boundary dials against p01-p05 would fit the set the preservation gates score. The scalars are transferred verbatim from the segmental-v3 frozen configuration instead.
It was frozen before any full-band result existed and has now bound two consecutive studies. Moving it now would convert a real constraint into a formality.

parameterPolicy: Scalar switch/duration/boundary dials are COPIED VERBATIM from segmental-harmony-v3-candidates.json and are not re-tuned here. Data-derived parameters (minimum dwell, segment minimum, confirmation frames, flicker thresholds) are computed via ml.evaluation.segmental.priors from data that is never the scored set: for GuitarSet, leave-one-performer-out over p01-p05, exactly the segmental-v3 policy; for full-band, from the 120 Slakh TRAINING compositions, never the development subset.

baseline.note: The gates compare against v1 as measured in pilot v2 under its production-parity decoder. v1 is the incumbent as it would actually run, so its baseline is not re-decoded.

candidates.note: The decoder pilot v2 actually used: uniform-penalty Viterbi at production parity, no smoothing. Must reproduce the frozen pilot-v2 rehearsal-heavy numbers exactly; if it does not, the harness is wrong and no other candidate in this study can be trusted.
Stickier base cost plus a soft short-dwell penalty ramping to zero by the 25th-percentile reference chord duration.
Duration constraint plus boundary gating. The boundary head is read here even though the pilot decode never read it.
Semi-Markov chord+boundary decode, chord-evidence confirmation and flicker reconciliation. The strongest over-segmentation control measured in segmental-v3.

evaluation.fullBandDevelopment: Slakh validation subset only; the untouched test split is never used for selection.
evaluation.guitarSetPreservation: p01-p05, both captures; p00 stays sealed.
evaluation.decoderAxisIsolation: Every candidate decodes the identical cached network response for each item, so differences are decoder-only by construction.

ifACandidateIsEligible: This would be the first eligible candidate in the workstream. Eligibility would justify unsealing p00 for a single confirmatory measurement, which is a separate frozen decision and is NOT part of this study.
knownLimitations: GuitarSet preservation is measured on p01-p05, which v1 trained on and which the base model rehearsed on. It is a forgetting check, not a held-out generalisation claim.
Reference labels for Slakh are note-level, so the full-band fragmentation gate remains not-evaluable and full-band regions/minute is not comparable to GuitarSet.
Slakh2100 is rendered from MIDI, so full-band evidence here is synthetic-domain.

Decoder scalars were frozen in segmental-v3 against a different model (full-v2). Transferring them unchanged is the honest choice available without tuning on the scored set, but it means no candidate here is tuned for this model.
